title: This is how it looks like when you see another plane passing close to...
description: This is how it looks like when you see another plane passing close to you in the sky. They seem to be very fast, but the speed is doubled as both planes moving towards each other. Anyways, it is the moment when I truly realize how high we fly above the ground when I see the other plane above the clouds. Plane spotting while flying is so cool!  #planespotting#planespotter#flying#plane#sky#airplane#avgeek
